correct.zh: 首先把「正常运行的时间」和「停机的时间」分开。总运行时间为 5,000 小时，故障总时间（花在修理上的时间）为 2,000 小时，因此实际正常运行的时间为 5,000－2,000＝3,000 小时。故障次数为 20 次，所以平均故障间隔 MTBF＝正常运行时间合计÷故障次数＝3,000÷20＝150 小时；平均修复时间 MTTR＝故障总时间÷故障次数＝2,000÷20＝100 小时。可用率是正常运行时间所占的比例，因此可用率＝MTBF÷(MTBF＋MTTR)＝150÷(150＋100)＝150÷250＝0.6，即 60%（直接用 3,000÷5,000＝0.6 求出也一样）。只有 エ 具备 MTBF 150 小时、MTTR 100 小时、可用率 60% 这一组合，所以 エ 是正确答案。
correct.en: First, separate the time the system was running from the time it was stopped. The total operating time is 5,000 hours and the total failure time (the time spent on repairs) is 2,000 hours, so the time the system was actually running is 5,000 - 2,000 = 3,000 hours. There were 20 failures, so MTBF (mean time between failures) = total up time ÷ number of failures = 3,000 ÷ 20 = 150 hours, and MTTR (mean time to repair) = total failure time ÷ number of failures = 2,000 ÷ 20 = 100 hours. Availability is the proportion of time the system is running, so availability = MTBF ÷ (MTBF + MTTR) = 150 ÷ (150 + 100) = 150 ÷ 250 = 0.6, that is 60% (calculating 3,000 ÷ 5,000 = 0.6 directly gives the same result). Only エ has the combination MTBF 150 hours, MTTR 100 hours, availability 60%, so エ is the correct answer.

distractors.zh: MTBF 与 MTTR 互换了，而且可用率也是错的。MTBF 100、MTTR 150 是把正常运行时间 3,000 小时和故障时间 2,000 小时弄反后相除得到的值。另外，可用率 40% 是 2,000÷5,000，即「停机时间所占的比例（发生故障的比例）」，并不是可用率。正确的是 MTBF 150、MTTR 100、可用率 60%。
distractors.en: MTBF and MTTR are swapped, and the availability is wrong as well. MTBF 100 and MTTR 150 come from mixing up the 3,000 hours of up time with the 2,000 hours of failure time when dividing. Also, the availability of 40% is 2,000 ÷ 5,000, which is the proportion of the time the system was stopped (the proportion of time it was failed), not the availability. The correct values are MTBF 150, MTTR 100, and availability 60%.

distractors.zh: 可用率 60% 虽然正确，但 MTBF 100、MTTR 150 互换了。MTBF 是「不发生故障、持续运行的平均时间」，所以分子是正常运行时间 3,000 小时（＝150 小时）；MTTR 是「每发生一次故障的平均修理时间」，所以分子是故障总时间 2,000 小时（＝100 小时）。在本题中 MTBF 比 MTTR 大。
distractors.en: The availability of 60% is correct, but MTBF 100 and MTTR 150 are swapped. MTBF is the average time the system keeps running without failing, so its numerator is the up time of 3,000 hours (= 150 hours); MTTR is the average repair time per failure, so its numerator is the total failure time of 2,000 hours (= 100 hours). In this question, MTBF is larger than MTTR.

distractors.zh: MTBF 150、MTTR 100 是正确的，但可用率 40% 错了。40% 是 2,000÷5,000，即停机时间所占的比例，而可用率是与之相反的 3,000÷5,000＝60%。用公式来说，可用率＝MTBF÷(MTBF＋MTTR)＝150÷250＝60%，这里把它与 MTTR÷(MTBF＋MTTR)＝100÷250＝40% 混淆了。
distractors.en: MTBF 150 and MTTR 100 are correct, but the availability of 40% is wrong. 40% is 2,000 ÷ 5,000, that is the proportion of the time the system was stopped, while availability is the opposite: 3,000 ÷ 5,000 = 60%. As a formula, availability = MTBF ÷ (MTBF + MTTR) = 150 ÷ 250 = 60%; this choice confuses it with MTTR ÷ (MTBF + MTTR) = 100 ÷ 250 = 40%.

points.zh: MTBF＝正常运行时间合计÷故障次数，MTTR＝故障（修理）时间合计÷故障次数。不要直接使用总运行时间，先分出「正常运行时间＝总运行时间－故障总时间」，这是第一步。
points.en: MTBF = total up time ÷ number of failures; MTTR = total failure (repair) time ÷ number of failures. The first step is not to use the total operating time as it is, but to separate out up time = total operating time - total failure time.

points.zh: 可用率＝MTBF÷(MTBF＋MTTR)＝正常运行时间÷总运行时间。注意：用 1 减去可用率得到的 MTTR÷(MTBF＋MTTR) 是「停机时间所占的比例」，不是可用率。
points.en: Availability = MTBF ÷ (MTBF + MTTR) = up time ÷ total operating time. Note that MTTR ÷ (MTBF + MTTR), which is availability subtracted from 1, is the proportion of stopped time, not the availability.
